en.basel-kadem: 1.	We were told by Muhammed bin Musa bin Mutawakkil, may Allah grant him mercy, that he said: We were told by Ali bin Hussain Sa’d-Abadi, from Ahmad bin Abi Abdillah al-Barqi, from Muhammed bin Salim, from Ahmad bin Nadhr al-Khazzaz, from Amru bin Shimr, from Jabir, from Abu Ja’far, peace be upon him, that he said:
For everything there is a spring, and the spring of the Qur’an is the month of Ramadhan.
